classic_engine.status: runtime mirror preserved; app.js, style.css and version.json unchanged

rules: No generated docked window bars or semantic wrappers.
Docked layout stays in the original Classic/39.1 DOM flow.
Window controls attach directly to existing native panels or native section headers.
Graphique and Marché are independent; Marché groups its existing market nodes without wrapping them while docked.
Administrator family headers remain their existing colored headers and retain all subsections inside the group.
Missions de vie remains one group containing its five existing programs.
Minimize masks presentation only and never suspends Classic runtime logic.
A floating shell exists only while detached and moves original DOM nodes; no business content is cloned.
Window Deck lists native workspaces only.

window_features: drag when free mode is enabled
global reset to native Classic flow
Escape restores maximized window or closes Window Deck

suspension_contract.reason: Classic 38.15.11 business runtime remains monolithic; 39.2.2 does not fake suspension.
suspension_contract.current_behavior: Minimize/hide affects presentation only; existing market, WebSocket, timer and analytical runtime behavior is preserved.
suspension_contract.future: True suspend/resume can be introduced module by module only after lifecycle-safe runtime separation.

supersedes.39.2.1: rejected: semantic wrappers/chrome altered the docked Classic layout

notes: 39.2.2 keeps the visual quality of Metal Base while correcting the window architecture.
Normal docked mode is the original interface plus discreet controls only; no WINDOW/Graphique/Marché bars are inserted.
The new storage namespace prevents rejected 39.2/39.2.1 window states from contaminating 39.2.2.
Classic /web remains the stable public reference; /administrator remains the operator cockpit.
